central_trap_meta_selection_bias.statement: Member families are candidates BECAUSE their explore results showed the hypothesized direction. Any explore-window composite statistic inherits this selection: under H0 (all effects zero), E[family explore mean | family was selected] > 0. Equal weights remove WEIGHT optimization but not MEMBERSHIP selection. Therefore an unconditional explore-window p-value for the composite is INADMISSIBLE as fresh evidence.
central_trap_meta_selection_bias.proposed_partial_correction: Selection-conditioned null: joint ISO-week block sign-flip permutation (same-week blocks flipped jointly across all member streams, preserving cross-family same-week correlation); a draw is ACCEPTED only if every prior-consistent member's permuted stream mean > 0 (matching the selection event that formed this book); p = P(composite statistic >= observed | all selection events). This asks 'does the composite exceed what selection alone manufactures?'
central_trap_meta_selection_bias.residual_dishonesty_attestation: Sign-conditioning is WEAKER than the true selection event (families were selected at specific observed magnitudes, e.g. rn p=0.117 not p=0.49, and the candidate list itself was human-curated from recorded verdicts). The conditional p is therefore a PARTIAL correction and remains anti-conservative to an unquantified degree. Consequence (frozen): explore PASS is a FEASIBILITY SCREEN only, never a claimable edge verdict. The ONLY claimable verdict for this family is the OOS single touch. This must survive into the freeze doc verbatim.
central_trap_meta_selection_bias.explore_reuse_attestation: The explore-window composite measurement re-analyzes data already touched by member families' explore runs (2014-2021). It adds NO new look at OOS 2022+. Member per-event/per-obs artifacts are in-repo frozen outputs of the original frozen harnesses; signals are NOT recomputed with any altered parameter.

power_preanalysis_from_recorded_aggregat.method: No new measurement. Implied annualized IR per family from recorded explore p-values: z = Phi^-1(1-p_one_sided), IR ~ z / sqrt(8y explore). Composite IR ~ sum(IR_i) / sqrt(K + K(K-1)*rho_bar) for average pairwise correlation rho_bar. OOS window = 4.5y -> t_oos ~ IR_c * sqrt(4.5).

K=3 (+vix): IR_c~0.81 -> t_oos~1.72 -> p~0.04 (marginal, ~55% power). With a selection haircut of 0.25 IR per family: K=3 IR_c~0.42 -> t_oos~0.89 (hopeless).

This math MUST be shown to the user before any OOS burn decision, and an UNDERPOWERED verdict branch must exist so a null OOS result does not overclaim falsification.
